note: results.json values are rounded to 4 decimals; position_rad = ankle angle in rad, negative = plantarflexion = toes down
toes_down_rule_check: OK: in every experiment/subject the 2 most negative positions have toes_down=1 and the other 6 have 0

D_identity_check.statement: r2 == r2_demeaned - bias^2/var_y  (var_y = rmse^2/(1-r2)); residual comes from 4-decimal rounding

E_note: fit/val/test MAE come from the epoch the run kept (restore_best_weights on val_loss). Val = the 20 % of each S1 trial that follows the first 80 % in time (dataset_builder._temporal_split lines 520-528), i.e. same session, same angle, adjacent in time. Test = the retest session (S2). So test/val above 1 = session shift (plus extra drift inside the trial), val/fit above 1 = classic over-fitting.
